publications.repeatability_requirement: Strict QS/TSV scientific data, schema and order; separately approved BAM coordinate-tie rule retained.

limits: Candidate cold preparation is already included once in all-attempt worker CPU; do not add it again.
Allocation UserCPU+SystemCPU is the primary actual-CPU measure; allocation TotalCPU is shown separately because display rounding differs. Steps are never added again.
Baseline preparation was warm/cached; no matched-cold preparation or end-to-end wall-time improvement is claimed.
Stage RSS is the maximum sampled task/step RSS, not simultaneous pipeline memory.
Frozen completion/accounting policy fails closed on unsuccessful native attempts; no retry-policy relaxation is applied.
No new scientific comparison or full data/SIF hashing is performed by this report writer.
Acceptance relies on the pinned completed scientific comparators and exact approved metadata/tie rules.
Validation and component-benchmark jobs are excluded from production worker/controller CPU.
Real second-round Lima was not benchmarked; prior fixtures are separate evidence.
